    CriticalPairExists from a point and a brick #

    PointBrickData asks, for a critical convex piece, for the data of Bongartz's Lemma 4 (BO23): a convex piece Sp, a point x, a brick V on Sp vanishing exactly at x and respecting the cover, and two independent extension tuples between S(x) and V (in either direction) whose extension blocks agree along related paths. By respectsCover_extRep, respectsCover_pointRep and sincere_of_point this gives CriticalPairExists (criticalPairExists_of_point).
